fields.Name: T290 - Integrations Connection Detail Entity Maps
fields.Description: Exercises SelectIntegrationCard() loading per-integration entity maps + schedule lookup and swapping the grid for the detail template — distinct from the connections list render (T140).

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, scroll to find the Integrations application, and open its 'Integrations' (Connections) section. Click on a connection card's body (the icon/name area, not the footer buttons) to open its detail view. Verify the view switches from the card grid to a detail screen showing a back arrow, the connection name/company header, a 'Sync Schedule' section, and an entity-maps toolbar with a map count (e.g. 'N entity maps · M active') and a filter box. If no connections exist, the empty 'No integrations yet' state is acceptable. Seeing the entity-maps detail view render is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking a connection card opens a detail view that replaces the card grid (back arrow + connection header visible)
The detail view shows a Sync Schedule section and an entity-maps area (list/table or an empty 'No entity maps configured' state)
OR, if no connections exist, a clear empty state is shown
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
